# Chirag Mirani

> Chirag Mirani works in investing, data science and quantitative research. He is based in Suwanee, Georgia, with about 20 years in quantitative finance and a Master of Science in Computational Finance from Carnegie Mellon University. He builds predictive models and forecasting systems across macroeconomics, rates, options, volatility, time series and prediction markets, and competes on Kaggle. In his spare time he builds iPhone and iPad apps (side projects, listed last).

## About
- Main work: investing, data science and quantitative research.
- Skills: Python, time series forecasting, machine learning, reinforcement learning, options and volatility modeling, macroeconomic forecasting, prediction-market modeling, backtesting.
- Evidence of work: a live US macro forecast dashboard with a public track record against Kalshi and actual releases; a published paper on exposure-adjusted strategy evaluation; Kaggle silver-medal notebook and a top 22% finish (379 of 1,711 teams) in the MITSUI Commodity Prediction Challenge.
- Current research: reinforcement learning and ARC-AGI-2 reasoning benchmarks (ARC Prize 2026).
- Profiles: GitHub https://github.com/ChiragMirani, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/chiragmirani/, Kaggle https://www.kaggle.com/cmirani, SSRN https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6292699

## Research
- [Live US macro forecast dashboard (MacroForecastbyCM)](https://chiragmirani.github.io/macro-dashboard/): house forecasts for major US economic releases next to Kalshi market consensus, with a public track record against actual releases. His main project.
- [Exposure-Time Normalized Performance (SSRN working paper, 2026)](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6292699): evaluating trading strategies by the time actually spent exposed to the market.

## Data science and machine learning
- Kaggle (https://www.kaggle.com/cmirani): silver-medal notebook; top 22% (379 of 1,711 teams) in the MITSUI Commodity Prediction Challenge; currently on ARC-AGI-2 (ARC Prize 2026) and NVARC.
- GitHub (https://github.com/ChiragMirani): code behind his research, models and projects.

## Side projects (apps built in his spare time)
Just for fun:
- [Flappy Tappy](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/): a one-tap arcade game he built for fun: fly through rings, aim for Bullseyes, and duel rivals from around the world. Play the Solo mode in a web browser: https://chiragmirani.github.io/flappy-tappy/. App Store (iPhone and iPad): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1203310957. Android (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.flappytappy

Learning for kids:
- [Vocabula: Grade Vocabulary](https://chiragmirani.github.io/vocabula-pages/app/): 4,241 vocabulary flashcards in English, Math and Science, Kindergarten through Grade 12, for iPhone and iPad. Works offline, no ads. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vocabula-k-12-vocabulary/id6819035983
- [VocabDeck](https://chiragmirani.github.io/zoes-vocabulary/): The iPhone/iPad app has 1,972 English cards; the browser edition has 4,296 English, Math and Science cards. No account or ads. The iOS app works offline. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761394575
- [Practice Combination Lock](https://chiragmirani.github.io/locklab/): an offline trainer for three-number rotary combination locks (0–39 dial), with Watch, Learn and Practice modes for the right-left-right sequence. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6822015018. Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/locklab/llms.txt

Finance and exam prep:
- [Series 65 Exam Practice Tests](https://chiragmirani.github.io/series65/): the Series 65 question bank he built and studied with before passing the exam on his first attempt in September 2026: 1,211 practice questions and 1,143 flashcards, every answer explained. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812059689. Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/series65/llms.txt
- [Compound Interest Calculators (Chip: Savings Plans & Goals)](https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-compound-calculator/): an offline compound interest calculator. Calculator, chart and Details are free; an optional one-time purchase adds comparisons, goals, saved plans and PDF/CSV reports. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6822411872. Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-compound-calculator/llms.txt
- [Chip Mortgage Calculator](https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-mortgage-calculator/): mortgage payments, schedules and comparisons for iPhone and iPad. Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-mortgage-calculator/llms.txt

Spirituality:
- [Shree Hanuman Chalisa (English)](https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/): the Hanuman Chalisa verse by verse in plain English, with the Hindi (Devanagari), the Hindi in English letters and Gujarati letters; all 43 verses, offline. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6819752072
- [The Vedas reader](https://chiragmirani.github.io/vedas/), [The Upanishads reader](https://chiragmirani.github.io/upanishads/) and [Gita](https://chiragmirani.github.io/gita-quotes/) (all 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gita in English).

## Weekly Treasury signal and working paper
- [Weekly U.S. 10-Year Treasury signal and duration checklist](https://chiragmirani.github.io/treasury-signal/): an additional timing check after forming a macro view. The dated page distinguishes calculated historical previews from actual issued forecasts.
- [A Simple Weekly Signal for the U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yield](https://chiragmirani.github.io/treasury-signal/paper/): Chirag Mirani, working paper version 4, November 7, 2026. Full readable text, PDF, reproducible code and results.
- [Latest signal JSON](https://chiragmirani.github.io/treasury-signal/data/latest.json) and [prospective weekly outcomes CSV](https://chiragmirani.github.io/treasury-signal/data/weekly-history.csv).
- Historical results are retrospectively selected yield-direction scores, not investment returns. Read reference dates, calculation/issue times and the historical/prospective status before describing a reading as current.
